- 2026-09-10: TechCrunch reported Muse at No. 2 in the US two days after its 2026-09-08 launch. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/10/metas-ai-agent-muse-is-now-the-no-2-app-in-the-us/)

## 4. Base rates
- By 2026-10-08 Muse had held #1 for about 3 weeks, apparently every day according to the Manifold description. A daily-reset chart rewards that kind of persistence, so a 7-day horizon is short compared with the streak so far.
- Comparable cases: past AI app launches (ChatGPT in 2023, DeepSeek in Jan 2025, Sora in Oct 2025) held #1 for anywhere from a few days to several weeks before they were overtaken. Seasonal apps and big event-driven apps (sports, shopping, finance) can also briefly take #1. I did not find a systematic dataset on how long #1 streaks last.
- Risks: the weak retention and engagement noted by Crypto Briefing, conflicting reports of Muse at No. 2 around Oct 6, and one-day spikes from other apps.

- The iPad launch (Oct 7) could add to Muse's momentum. iPad downloads should not count toward the iPhone chart, though.
